title: Surface organization identity on job postings
goal: Render the owning organization name and badge on job postings created by organizations so postings are not mislabeled as Venue staffing or null-org, per SIM-20260922-ORG-003.

in: Inspect how job postings resolve owner (organization vs venue) and current labels
Render org name/badge on the postings surface and fix null-org display
out: Mislabeling organization postings as venue staffing

acceptance_criteria: SIM-20260922-ORG-003 reruns and passes with receiving-side UI evidence

progress.summary: Local fix verified and green on the dirty worktree (2026-09-24 verification round): organization-owned job postings surface an organization source badge and a server-resolved org display name on the unified jobs board, fixing the SIM-20260922-ORG-003 null-org / 'Venue staffing' mislabel. Venue-owned postings keep the unchanged venue default label. Focused tests (organization 8 files/38 tests, jobs 2 files/24 tests) and scope-limited eslint all pass; agents:validate reports 0 errors (8 pre-existing generated-map SHA-drift warnings; maps intentionally not regenerated because restamping would capture 140 unrelated in-tree entries). Implementation files and route wiring were re-reviewed against the finding this round and confirm: mapper branches on employer_entity_type, org display name derives server-side from organizer_accounts brand (ops_org_id) with organizations.name fallback, GET /api/jobs attaches org identity before mapping on both merge and non-merge paths, and both board and detail badges branch on organization source. Acceptance (receiving-side UI rerun credit on isolated staging) remains pending hosted simulation evidence.
completed: Branch the unified template mapper on employer_entity_type so org templates emit source 'organization' with a resolved display name instead of hardcoded source 'venue' (lib/rebuild/unified-jobs-list.ts).

Add organization-domain display-name resolution (lib/organizations/job-postings-identity.ts): prefers public brand name from organizer_accounts (ops_org_id bridge), falls back to canonical organizations.name; degrades to null names, never fabricates a label; server-side only.
Wire GET /api/jobs to attach resolved org identity to org-owned templates before mapping; venue embed and venue_id filter behavior unchanged.
Render the org badge on the unified board (app/jobs/page.tsx) and the posting detail page (app/jobs/[id]/page.tsx); preserved org identity in the legacy staff_postings fallback mapping on the board.
Tests: __tests__/organization/org-job-postings-identity.test.ts (mapper branching + resolver), plus route contract assertions in __tests__/jobs/jobs-flow.test.ts.
next_steps: Rerun SIM-20260922-ORG-003 / ORG-07 on isolated staging once RELEASE-007/QA-003 (staging URL, deployed SHA, deployment ID, separate Supabase origin, Stripe test mode), DB-008/DB-002/DB-010 database hosted proof, QA-005/QA-006 actor+mobile packets are attached to the same deployed SHA.

Follow-up candidates: resolve org display name on the /api/job-postings/[id] detail route so the detail page shows the org name (not just the badge); decide venue_id filter semantics for org postings (currently still excluded under a venue_id filter).
blockers: Receiving-side UI rerun credit requires isolated-staging deployment + protected campaign actors (sim-org-manager-01 / sim-worker-01), which the agent-user-simulation campaign keeps blocked until RELEASE-007/QA-003, DB-008/DB-002/DB-010, QA-005/QA-006, and QA-004 staging packets are attached; no hosted mutation performed per working agreements.
No hosted database apply was run (CP-051, additive migrations only on operator instruction); org-name resolution was implemented with existing schema and requires no migration.
